claim.title: Reparations
claim.text:
Forensic Evaluation and Restitutionary Brief

Ty Mawr (Great House Farm), Llandough
Semantic Version 0.6

This brief is submitted to invite judicial, parliamentary, and public scrutiny of the historical dispossession of Ty Mawr (Great House Farm), Llandough, and to set out grounds upon which the matter should be reopened, investigated, and remedied.

The Williams-Buckler family's claim for reparations arising from the dispossession of Great House Farm, Llandough, Glamorgan, Wales, in December 1988.

The family seeks £101.2 million in reparations for the forcible eviction, demolition of an 800-year-old home, and destruction of archaeological and documentary evidence spanning from 1667 to 1988.

Semantic Version 0.7
